name: Yanello
summary: Yanello is a combatant who uses a magical wand to summon elaborate transportation-themed attacks to deal heavy damage.

source.parsed_text:
Yanello is ...


Special moves:
- Magic wand, pulls out and uses a glittery fairy wand on you to make an uber drive by, pull you in, drive you off to the airport, followed by a plain flying off in the distance with a figure falling out, which is the player, hitting the ground for major damage.

inferred_stats.reason: Relies on high-damage magic wand summons resulting in major impact damage

expressions.victory: Triumphant laugh with wand held high

victory_pose: Yanello dramatically flourishes the fairy wand as sparkles rain down, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied grin.
taunts: Need a ride out of here?
Hope you remembered to pack your bags.

specials.name: Magic wand
specials.description: Pulls out a glittery fairy wand to summon an uber drive-by that pulls the enemy in, drives them to the airport, and drops them from an airplane for major damage.
pose_frames: Waving a glittery fairy wand forward with a flash of light
Points the wand skyward with a flourish as the aircraft flies past
specials.prop: A shiny, glittery star-tipped fairy wand

proportions: a slim, slender build: noticeably thinner than an average adult, narrow waist and hips, slim arms and legs, realistic adult proportions; same patterned blue sweater and blue jeans; she wears shoes, never barefoot: simple dark brown leather flat shoes
